help.expense: Something you bought or a service you used. With a party, any unpaid part is remembered as money you owe.
help.sale: Something you sold or earned. With a party, any unpaid part is remembered as money owed to you.
help.payment: Money you paid to a party, matched to their bills.
help.receipt: Money a party paid you, matched to their sales.
help.transfer: Moving money between your own cash and bank accounts is not income or expense.
help.owner: Money the owner adds, or household spending from farm money. Neither is farm income or expense.
help.loan: A loan is not income. Interest is recorded when you repay.
help.loan-repayment: Only the interest part is an expense.
help.settlement: Nets what a trader owes you against what you owe them. No cash moves.
help.write-off: A due that will never be paid. It is recorded as a loss.
help.opening: Your cash, bank, dues, loans and farm assets on the day you start using SmartFarm360.
help.depreciation: The part of a farm asset’s cost used up in this period.

ledger.4900: Gain on sale of farm assets

allocation.title: Share farm overhead with crops
allocation.help: Costs for the whole farm (electricity, repairs, a watchman) are shared by the crops growing in the period, by area × days. The farm's totals do not change; only each crop's share does. Interest and losses are never shared.
allocation.preview: Show how it would be shared
allocation.nothing: There is no farm overhead in this period.
allocation.noCrops: No crop was growing on this farm in the period; this stays as farm overhead.

fin.confirmDiscard: Discard this draft? It was never posted, so your accounts do not change.
fin.confirmCorrect: Correct this record? It will be reversed today, and a copy will open for you to fix and save.
fin.noRecordsHere: No money records here yet. Add an expense to start.
fin.correcting: Correcting {{number}}: the original was reversed. Fix the details below and save.

stock.title: Stock
stock.subtitle: What is in store, where it is, and what it is worth.
stock.reconciliationProblem: Stock in the accounts differs from the value of stock on hand by {{amount}}. Please report this.
stock.valuationHelp: Stock is valued at moving average cost. Farm produce is carried at nil value; its growing costs are already counted as costs of the crop or animals.
stock.itemsHelp: Things you keep count of: inputs you buy and use, produce from the farm, and goods you buy to sell.
stock.name: Name
stock.trackLots: Track lots or batches (seed, chemicals, medicine, feed)
stock.packUnitsHelp: For example, a bag of 45 {{unit}}. Quantities can then be entered in bags.
stock.showInactive: Show items no longer in use
stock.needsReviewHelp: Moved from the old stock screen; please check its unit and quantity, then mark it reviewed.
stock.locationsHelp: Where stock is kept, such as the main store or a field shed. Stock in all locations shares one average cost.
stock.reconciled: The accounts agree with the store.
stock.notReconciled: The accounts do not agree with the store.

warning.LOT_EXPIRED: {{item}}: lot {{lot}} had expired. It was used as you asked.

help.issue: Stock used on a crop or on the farm in general. It becomes a cost at its average value.
help.produce: Harvest, milk, eggs or compost put into stock. Farm produce has no stock value.
help.transfer: Moving stock changes where it is, not what it is worth.
help.wastage: Stock that spoiled or was lost. Its value is shown as a loss.
help.count: Enter what you counted. Differences from the records are shown as losses or gains.
help.purchase-return: Stock sent back. The credit reduces what you owe the supplier.
help.sale-return: Stock a customer brought back. It returns at the cost it left with.

errors.item: Choose a stock item for every line.
errors.quantity: Enter a valid quantity (up to 4 decimals).
errors.lot: Enter the lot or batch number.
errors.reason: Say why the stock was wasted.
errors.originalSale: Choose the sale the stock was sold on.
errors.packUnit: Each pack unit needs a name and how much it contains.

transfer.action: Use own produce on another activity
transfer.title: Use own produce on another activity
transfer.help: Compost on a field, fodder to the herd, dung into a compost pit. This is never income: the quantity moves, and where the rule says so, the cost of producing it moves too.
transfer.previewCost: Average cost {{unitCost}} per {{unit}} ({{costs}} of costs ÷ {{produced}} produced): {{amount}} moves with it.
transfer.previewNil: Only the quantity moves; no cost moves with it.
transfer.rules: Compost from your own batches carries its cost per kg to the field by default. Dung, straw, fodder and other produce move without cost unless an owner or accountant chooses average cost.
transfer.report: Own produce used on the farm

errors.form: Choose the produce, a quantity, and the activity that uses it.

trading.title: Trading margin
trading.help: Goods bought for resale: what was bought and sold, the cost of what was sold at average cost, and the margin.
trading.needsFinance: The trading margin needs permission to see money.
trading.none: No goods bought for resale moved in this period.
trading.note: Produce bought and then processed is not trading; it is an input of the processing batch.

crop.title: Crops
crop.sub: Each cultivation cycle from planning to harvest, with what it cost and earned.
crop.setupHelp: Crops, their varieties, the stock item each harvest goes into, and seasons.
crop.weatherHelp: Rainfall and weather notes you record for each farm.
crop.areaHelp: Leave the area empty to use the whole field. Two crops can share a field at the same time (intercropping).

confirm.CLOSE: Close this cycle? No new field records can be added until it is reopened.
confirm.CANCEL: Cancel this cycle? It was never grown.

warning.FIELD_OVERCOMMITTED: Crops growing on this field at the same time need more area than it has.

crop.noCycles: No crop cycles yet. Start one to record field work and harvests.
crop.estimatePrice: Price for unsold produce (₹ per {{unit}}, estimate)
crop.memoHelp: Recorded before the accounts (not in profit): activity costs {{cost}}, harvest value {{value}}.
crop.paidWorkToggle: Labour or machine hire was paid for this work
crop.recordOnceHelp: Inputs leave stock and paid work is recorded in the accounts, both against this cycle. You record them only here.
crop.confirmReverse: Reverse this record? Stock and money it moved are put back.
crop.harvestIntoItem: The harvest goes into stock as {{item}}, as a new lot, at nil value.
crop.harvestNewItem: The first harvest creates the stock item {{crop}} (farm produce, in kg); each harvest is a lot.
crop.comparisonHelp: Every cycle of this crop side by side: plan against actual, yield, cost per acre and profit (from posted records).
crop.noWeather: No weather notes for these dates.

errors.rainfall: Enter rainfall in mm (up to one decimal).

crop.animalFarm: {{farm}} is not a crop farm. Its birds or animals are tracked under {{section}}: the number you have, what you paid, daily eggs or milk, sales and profit. A crop cycle needs a field and a crop.
crop.noFieldsYet: This farm has no fields yet.
crop.workAndMoney: Work and money for this crop
crop.entryCostHelp: Paid for this work or bought something for it? Enter the amount and it is booked to this crop as an expense. Leave it empty for a note of the work only.

workforce.title: Workers & wages
workforce.attendanceHelp: Mark the day for everyone at once, then change the few who differ. Choose the crop worked on so wages go to its cost.
workforce.workersHelp: Everyone you pay for farm work, with the wages they are owed and the advances they still owe back.
workforce.payHelp: Work out wages for a period from attendance and piece work, post them, then pay and recover advances.
workforce.noWorkers: No workers yet. Add them under Workers.
workforce.noPieceWork: No piece work on this day.
workforce.name: Name
workforce.confirmLeaving: Mark this worker as left? They must be paid up and have no advance.
workforce.balanceHelp: Balance is wages owed less advance to recover. Below zero means the worker owes the farm.
workforce.nothingToPay: Nothing to pay for this period.

skipped.ALREADY_PAID: {{name}} is already in a pay run for part of this period.
skipped.PARTIAL_MONTH: {{name}} is paid monthly; choose whole calendar months.

workforce.payRunPosted: Wages for {{from}} to {{to}} posted. Pay them below.

errors.nameAndRate: Enter a name and a rate in rupees.
errors.amount: Enter amounts in rupees, up to two decimals.

workforce.noLabour: No posted wages in this month.
workforce.paidByBill: also on a labour bill for this day — check it is not paid twice

assets.title: Assets
assets.registerHelp: Equipment, vehicles, irrigation, buildings and breeding animals, with what they cost and are worth now.
assets.depreciationHelp: Each month's wear on your assets, posted one month at a time in order. Reverse the latest run to correct it.
assets.maintenanceHelp: Servicing that is due or overdue, by date or hours of use.
assets.name: Asset
assets.animalNotDepreciated: Breeding and milch animals are not depreciated.
assets.registerLine: Register this cost as an asset
assets.noAssets: No assets in the register yet.
assets.unregistered: Asset costs not in the register
assets.unregisteredHelp: Bills and opening balances on Farm assets that are not yet registered. Register them so they are depreciated.
assets.noUnregistered: Every asset cost is in the register.

errors.details: Enter a name and, unless it is a breeding animal, the useful life in months.
errors.bill: Enter the cost, and who it was bought from or the account it was paid from.
errors.proceeds: Enter the sale amount, and who bought it or the account it came into.
errors.plan: Enter a name and how often: every so many days or hours.

assets.confirmRemove: Remove this asset from the register? The bill stays in the accounts.
assets.disposalHelp: Book value now is {{bookValue}}. The difference from the sale amount is recorded as a gain or loss. The month of sale is not depreciated.
assets.confirmSell: Record this sale? It posts to the accounts.
assets.confirmScrap: Scrap this asset? Its book value is recorded as a loss.
assets.runningCostsHelp: Fuel, repairs and other bills tagged with this asset, plus its depreciation.
assets.reverseHelp: To correct a run, open its record and reverse it. Only the latest month can be reversed.
assets.reconciled: The register agrees with the accounts.
assets.notReconciled: The register does not agree with the accounts. Register the missing costs or check depreciation entered by hand.
assets.noPlans: No service plans. Add them on an asset's page.

export.actualPosted: Actual: posted records only; drafts are not included

reports.amountsHidden: Amounts are hidden for your role
reports.balanceSignHelp: Above zero: they owe the farm. Below zero: the farm owes them.
reports.actualPosted: Actual figures: posted records only, drafts not included
reports.catalogHelp: Every report you can open. Each one can be exported as CSV or Excel, or printed and saved as PDF.
reports.noReports: Your role has no reports to open.

catalog.herdProfit: Herd profitability and cost per litre
catalog.internalTransfers: Own produce used on the farm

catalogHint.income: income, costs and profit for a period
catalogHint.categories: where the money went, with comparisons
catalogHint.balanceSheet: what the farm has and owes on a date
catalogHint.cashFlow: money in and out of cash and bank
catalogHint.partyStatement: choose a customer, supplier or lender
catalogHint.trialBalance: every account's debits and credits (for accountants)
catalogHint.cropCycles: open a cycle for its figures
catalogHint.stockValue: value on a date, against the accounts
catalogHint.wages: days, wages, payments and advances by worker
catalogHint.runningCosts: depreciation, running costs and use by asset
catalogHint.depreciation: monthly runs and the register against the accounts
catalogHint.herdProfit: each group's revenue, costs and cost per litre
catalogHint.milkReport: litres produced and where they went
catalogHint.breedingCalendar: checks, dry-offs, calvings and health due
catalogHint.herdRegister: every animal with its group and state
catalogHint.pondCycles: Survival, FCR, yield and profit per acre for each pond crop
catalogHint.waterLog: Readings by pond, with values outside your limits marked
catalogHint.organicBatches: Yield, cost per kg and cost moved to your fields
catalogHint.internalTransfers: Compost, dung, fodder and straw moved between activities, with the cost moved
catalogHint.processingBatches: Outturn, process loss and cost per kg of the finished product
catalogHint.lotTrace: From a bag of rice back to the field, and from a harvest to the customers
catalogHint.tradingMargin: Goods bought for resale: sold, cost of sales and gross margin

help.monthly: Each month's income and costs. The total column equals profit and loss for the whole period.
help.categories: Where the money went, largest first, with each category's share.
help.balanceSheet: What the farm has, what it owes, and the owner's money, on one date.
help.trialBalance: Every ledger account's opening balance, debits, credits and closing balance.
help.wages: Days worked, wages earned and paid, and advances, by worker.
help.runningCosts: Depreciation, fuel and repairs, hours of use and maintenance, by asset.

reports.notBalanced: The accounts do not balance by {{amount}}. Please tell your accountant.
reports.fiscalYearNote: Profit this financial year counts from {{date}}.
reports.accountantsOnly: The trial balance is for owners and accountants who manage the accounts.
reports.trialBalanceHelp: Debits and credits are equal and closing balances add up to zero when the books are in order.
reports.postedOnly: posted records only, drafts not included

dashboard.allClearHelp: Dues, stock, workers and assets are all in order.

livestock.name: Name
livestock.title: Livestock
livestock.herdHelp: Every cow and buffalo, its group, breeding state and lactation.
livestock.milkHelp: Record each group's morning and evening milk, as a total or per animal. Each day's milk goes into stock.
livestock.careHelp: What is due: pregnancy checks, dry-offs, calvings, vaccinations and dewormings.
livestock.groupsHelp: Feed, medicine, labour and depreciation are costs of a group, so each group shows what it costs and earns.
livestock.createGroupFirst: Create a group first, for example Milking herd.
livestock.boughtHelp: A bought animal is a farm asset: the bill is recorded and she is depreciated to her cull value over her productive life.
livestock.datesWorkedOut: The pregnancy check (from day 60), expected calving (day {{days}}) and dry-off (60 days before) are worked out from this date.
livestock.noAdvice: SmartFarm360 records what was done. It does not diagnose or recommend treatment; ask your vet.
livestock.exitRegisteredHelp: This animal is in the asset register: a sale records a gain or loss against her book value; a death writes her book value off as a loss.
livestock.exitHomeBredHelp: Home-bred animals have no book value: a sale is recorded as Livestock sales; a death needs no money record.
livestock.confirmExit: Record that this animal has left the herd?
livestock.withheldWarning: Milk withheld after treatment, do not sell: {{animals}}
livestock.noMilkingGroups: No milking group. Create one under Groups.
livestock.usesHelp: Home use and milk fed to calves carry no value; discarded milk is recorded as wastage. Sales are recorded below.
livestock.buyerHelp: the dairy society, or leave empty for a cash sale
livestock.saleHelp: Enter the litres and the amount on the society's bill. The price is not worked out from fat and SNF.
livestock.groupHealth: Health event for a whole group
livestock.herdHelpReport: Each group's own revenue and costs. Farm overhead is not shared out to herds; cost per litre is costs divided by litres produced.

errors.tagAndGroup: Enter a tag and choose a group.
errors.purchase: Enter the price, and who sold her or the account it was paid from.
errors.noMilk: Enter the litres for at least one session.
errors.litres: Enter litres as numbers with up to two decimals.
errors.sale: Enter the group, litres, bill amount and the buyer or account.
errors.groupHealth: Choose the group and say what was done.
errors.nameAndHeads: Enter a name and the number of birds or animals.
errors.wholeNumbers: Enter whole numbers, and kg with up to three decimals.
errors.feed: Choose the feed and enter its kg, or leave both empty.
errors.toGroup: Choose the group they moved to.
errors.saleKg: Enter the live weight for a price per kg.
errors.countReason: Say why the count changed, for example "recounted the shed".

livestock.poultryHelp: Each batch of birds: heads, the daily record of deaths, eggs and feed, and what the batch earned.
livestock.smallStockHelp: Each goat or sheep herd counted as a group: births, deaths, sales and what the herd earned.
livestock.youngStockHelp: The bill is a cost of this batch or herd, under Chicks and young stock.
livestock.noHerds: No goat or sheep herds yet.
livestock.headsAtEnd: Birds at the end of the day: {{count}}
livestock.dailyRecordHelp: Deaths and culls lower the count; feed is taken from stock as a cost of the batch; good and cracked eggs go into stock. Saving again replaces the day.

warning.EGGS_WITHHELD: Eggs withheld after treatment: do not sell eggs from this batch yet.
warning.HIGH_MORTALITY: More than 1% of the birds died today.

livestock.countHelp: The difference from the recorded number is saved as a count correction with your note. A batch counted to zero is closed.
livestock.eggUsesHelp: Taken from the egg stock of all batches. Home use carries no value; damaged eggs are recorded as wastage.
livestock.healthPlanHelp: Vaccinations and dewormings planned for this batch or herd. Marking one done records a health event for the whole group.
livestock.copyPlanHelp: Each vaccination is planned for the same age of the birds as in the other batch.
livestock.flocksHelpReport: Each batch's or herd's own revenue and costs in the period. Hen-day % is eggs per bird per day.
livestock.countReasonExample: e.g. recounted the shed, birds bought locally

aquaculture.title: Fish farming
aquaculture.pondsHelp: Each pond, the crop of fish in it and its latest water reading.
aquaculture.startCycleHelp: Start the crop when you begin preparing the pond, so liming and manuring are costs of this crop.
aquaculture.estimateHelp: Fish cannot be counted in the pond. These are stocked fish less deaths seen and fish harvested, and the latest sample's weight. The true survival is known at the final harvest.
aquaculture.stockingHelp: Enter the number and their total weight, so the starting size is known. The seed bill is a cost of this crop. Shrimp seed can be entered in thousands, for example 200000.
aquaculture.notesExample: Water green, fish surfacing at dawn
aquaculture.dailyRecordHelp: Feed is taken from stock as a cost of this crop, once for the day. Saving again replaces the day.
aquaculture.saleNeedsFinance: Recording a sale needs permission to record money.
aquaculture.harvestHelp: Fish sold are one sale of Fish sales to the buyer. Charges the buyer took off are a cost of this crop, so the net is what you received. Fish are not kept in stock. Give the number of fish on every line of the final harvest to see survival.
aquaculture.confirmFinal: A final harvest closes this crop. Continue?
aquaculture.cyclesHelpReport: Each crop's own revenue and costs in the period. Survival and FCR are shown once the final harvest is in the period.
aquaculture.waterHelp: Readings from every pond, compared with the limits you set. SmartFarm360 does not suggest limits or treatments.
aquaculture.limitsHelp: Set the lowest and highest values you accept. Readings outside them are marked and shown on the dashboard. Nothing is filled in for you.
aquaculture.pondLimitsHelp: Limits here replace your general limits for this pond only. Leave a row empty to use the general limit.

errors.pond: Enter the pond's name, farm and water area.
errors.day: Choose the feed and kg on each feed line, and the species and number on each line of deaths.
errors.stocking: Enter the species, number of fish and their total kg.
errors.seedBill: Enter the bill amount and who was paid or the account it was paid from.
errors.sample: Enter the fish weighed and their total kg.
errors.harvest: Each line needs the species and kg, and a price for fish sold. Amounts take up to two decimals.
errors.buyer: Choose the buyer or the account the money came into.
errors.reading: Enter at least one measurement, as a number.

organic.title: Organic manure and compost
organic.batchesHelp: Each compost pit, vermicompost bed or liquid manure: what went in, what was done, what came out and what it cost.
organic.confirmFinish: A finished batch takes no more inputs or log entries. Continue?
organic.useOutput: Use the output on a field
organic.movesHelp: Dung, straw and residues from your herd and fields come in without cost. Output used on your fields carries the batch's cost per kg.
organic.lastOutput: This is the last output; mark the batch finished
organic.outputHelp: Output goes into stock as farm produce at nil value; its cost stays with this batch until it is used on a field.
organic.manureHelp: Dung or litter goes into stock as farm produce of that herd or batch, at nil value.
organic.batchesHelpReport: Costs are before any cost moved to your fields; profit is revenue less the costs that stayed with the batch.

errors.batch: Enter a name and choose the farm.
errors.log: Enter kg and temperature as numbers.
errors.output: Choose the item and enter the quantity.
errors.manure: Choose where it was collected, the item and the quantity.

processing.title: Processing
processing.batchesHelp: Each run of cleaning, drying, milling, pressing or packing: what went in, what came out, and the cost per kg.
processing.batchHelp: The code is used in the lot numbers of the output, so every bag can be traced.
processing.confirmFinish: A finished batch takes no more inputs, steps or output. Continue?
processing.inputsHelp: Your own harvest comes in with its growing cost per kg. Bought produce and packing material are used from stock; hired milling and labour are bills to this batch.
processing.stepsHelp: Steps are a record of the work; they do not move stock. Output does.
processing.lastOutput: This is the last output; mark the batch finished
processing.outputNeedsStock: Putting output into stock needs permission to record stock.
processing.outputHelp: Products and byproducts go into stock at nil value, with lot numbers made from the batch code when the item tracks lots. Waste is recorded in kg only.
processing.mainCostPerKg: Cost per kg of main product
processing.batchesHelpReport: Cost per kg of the main product = (costs − byproduct sales) ÷ main product kg. Compare it with the raw material's cost per kg and the market price.
processing.traceHelp: Enter a lot number to see where it came from and where it went.

errors.batch: Enter a code (letters, numbers and dashes), a name, the main product and the farm.
errors.step: Enter kg and moisture as numbers.
errors.output: Choose the item (or say what the waste is) and enter the quantity.

email.footer: SmartFarm360 · You get this email because of your SmartFarm360 account. If you did not expect it, you can ignore it.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your SmartFarm360 password

registrationAttempt.subject: Someone tried to register with your email
registrationAttempt.body: Someone tried to create a SmartFarm360 account with this email address, which already has one. If it was you, sign in, or reset your password if you forgot it.

invitation.subject: You are invited to {{tenant}} on SmartFarm360

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body:
Welcome to SmartFarm360. Please confirm this is your email address by opening this link within 48 hours:
{{url}}

exportReady.subject: Your export of {{tenant}} is ready
exportReady.body: The export of {{tenant}} is ready. Download it from Settings, Your data, within 7 days; then it is removed.

deletionScheduled.subject: {{tenant}} will be deleted on {{date}}
deletionScheduled.body:
An owner asked for {{tenant}} to be deleted. Until {{date}} it is read-only, and any owner can cancel the deletion or export the data from Settings. After that date all its records are deleted for good.

Keeping the books for tax purposes is the owner's responsibility: export them before the deletion.

deletionCancelled.subject: The deletion of {{tenant}} was cancelled
deletionCancelled.body: An owner cancelled the deletion of {{tenant}}. It works as before.

deletionDone.subject: {{tenant}} has been deleted
deletionDone.body: As asked, {{tenant}} and all its records have been deleted from SmartFarm360. Copies in backups expire on their normal schedule, as the privacy notice explains.

supportAccessGranted.subject: Support access to {{tenant}} is on
supportAccessGranted.body: SmartFarm360 support can now read {{tenant}} until {{until}} (UTC). They cannot change anything. Every page they open is listed in the activity log, and an owner can end the access from Settings, Support.

adminSignIn.subject: New sign-in to your SmartFarm360 administrator account
adminSignIn.body: Your platform administrator account signed in at {{time}} (UTC). If it was not you, reset your password now and tell the other administrators.

accountDeleted.subject: Your SmartFarm360 account was deleted
accountDeleted.body: Your SmartFarm360 account has been deleted, as you asked. Records you made for farm businesses stay in their books under a former-member label.

trialEnding.subject: Your SmartFarm360 trial for {{tenant}} ends in {{days}} day(s)

trialEnded.subject: The trial of {{tenant}} has ended
trialEnded.body:
The trial of {{tenant}} has ended and the free plan applies. Everything you recorded is still there. To get more members and farms, choose a plan:
{{url}}

paymentReceived.subject: Payment received: invoice {{number}}
paymentReceived.body:
Thank you. We received {{amount}} (GST included) for {{tenant}}. Tax invoice {{number}} is in Settings, Plan and billing, where owners and accountants can download it:
{{url}}

renewalFailed.subject: The renewal payment for {{tenant}} failed

graceEnding.subject: Pay by {{date}} to keep the plan of {{tenant}}
graceEnding.body:
The renewal for {{tenant}} is still unpaid. On {{date}} the free plan applies. Pay here:
{{url}}

planLapsed.subject: The plan of {{tenant}} has lapsed
planLapsed.body:
The renewal for {{tenant}} was not paid, so the free plan's limits now apply. Nothing you recorded is hidden or deleted. Paying brings the plan back from that day:
{{url}}

priceChange.subject: The price of the {{plan}} plan changes on {{date}}
priceChange.body:
From {{date}}, the {{plan}} plan of {{tenant}} costs {{amount}} before GST. Renewals from that date charge the new price. You can change or cancel the plan before then:
{{url}}

refundIssued.subject: Refund of {{amount}} for {{tenant}}
refundIssued.body:
We refunded {{amount}} to the payment method used. Credit note {{number}} is in Settings, Plan and billing. The bank may take a few days to show it.
{{url}}

account.title: Your account
account.emailNotVerified: Your email address is not confirmed yet. Open the link we sent you to create a farm business.
account.verificationSent: We sent a new link. It works for 48 hours.
account.verifyBanner: Confirm your email address to create a farm business.
account.twoStepHelp: After your password, also enter a code from an authenticator app on your phone. Recommended for owners.
account.twoStepRequired: Platform administrators must use two-step sign-in.
account.twoStepOnSignInAgain: Two-step sign-in is on. Next time you sign in you will be asked for a code.
account.scanOrType: Add SmartFarm360 to your authenticator app with the link below, or type the key.
account.recoveryCodesHelp: Keep these somewhere safe. Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
account.marketing: Send me news and offers from SmartFarm360 by email
account.deleteAccountHelp: Your name and email are removed and you can no longer sign in. Records you made for farm businesses stay in their books under a former-member label. If you are the only owner of a farm business, make someone else an owner or delete the business first.
account.deleteAccountConfirm: Delete your account for good? This cannot be undone.

tenantOps.deletionBanner: This farm business will be deleted on {{date}}. Until then it is read-only.
tenantOps.supportHelp: Let SmartFarm360 support read this farm business to help you. They cannot change anything, and every page they open is in the activity history.
tenantOps.exportHelp: Download everything recorded for this farm business: a ZIP of spreadsheet (CSV) and JSON files. We email you when it is ready; it is kept 7 days.
tenantOps.exportStarted: The export has started. We will email you when it is ready.
tenantOps.deleteHelp: Everything recorded here is deleted after 30 days. Until then the business is read-only and any owner can cancel. Keeping the books for tax is your responsibility: export them first.
tenantOps.deletionPending: Deletion on {{date}}, asked by {{email}}. It is read-only until then.

billing.title: Plan and billing
billing.endsOn: Paid until {{date}}; it does not renew
billing.graceUntil: Pay by {{date}} to keep the plan
billing.checkoutWaiting: A payment was started. The plan changes when the payment gateway confirms it.
billing.upgradeWaiting: An upgrade is waiting for its payment.
billing.neverLocked: If a plan ends, nothing you recorded is hidden or locked: only adding more than the free plan allows is refused.
billing.changeScheduled: The change is saved. A higher plan starts once paid; a lower plan or another period starts at the next renewal.
billing.profileFirst: Fill in the billing details below before choosing a plan.
billing.payOnGateway: You pay on the payment gateway's secure page by UPI, card or net banking. SmartFarm360 never sees your card or bank details.
billing.cancelConfirm: Cancel the plan? It stays until the end of the paid period, then the free plan applies.
billing.cancelled: The plan is cancelled. It stays until the end of the paid period.
billing.gstinOptional: Optional, to claim input tax credit
billing.profileSaved: The billing details are saved. Invoices issued before keep the details they had.
billing.booked: The invoice is recorded as a bill from SmartFarm360 in your books.

banner.TRIAL_ENDING: Your trial ends on {{date}}. Choose a plan to keep its limits.
banner.PAST_DUE: The renewal payment failed. Pay by {{date}} to keep your plan.
banner.LAPSED: Your plan lapsed and the free plan's limits apply. Nothing is hidden; pay to get your plan back.

billing.returned: Thank you. Your plan changes as soon as the payment gateway confirms the payment, usually within a minute.
billing.managedOnWeb: The plan is managed on the SmartFarm360 website, in Settings.
